sn56.35:1.3: ehambho purisa pubbaṇhasamayaṃ taṃ sattisatena hanissanti majjhantikasamayaṃ sattisatena hanissanti sāyaṇhasamayaṃ sattisatena hanissanti.
sn56.35:1.4: so kho tvaṃ ambho purisa divase divase tīhi sattisatehi haññamāno vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvī vassasatassa accayena anabhisametāni cattāri ariyasaccāni abhisamessasīti.
sn56.35:2.4: pubbā koṭi na paññāyati sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ pharasuppahārānaṃ.
sn56.35:2.6: na kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave saha dukkhena saha domanassena catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ abhisamayaṃ vadāmi.
sn56.35:2.7: apicāhaṃ bhikkhave sahāva sukhena sahāva somanassena catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ abhisamayaṃ vadāmi.
sn56.35:3.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
